ud4.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe .
ud4.9:1.3: atha kho āyasmato Upasenassa Vaṅgantaputtassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
ud4.9:1.4: lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me
ud4.9:1.5: satthā ca me bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho,
ud4.9:1.6: svākhyāte c' amhi dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito,
ud4.9:1.12: bhaddakaṃ me jīvitaṃ bhaddakaṃ maraṇan ti.
